name: Customer email reply drafter
purpose: Drafts a reply to a customer email in English, Italian or Albanian that follows the cancellation policy and the price list, and flags anything a manager must decide.

inputs.name: client_email
inputs.label: Client email (full text)
inputs.hint: Paste the whole email, including the sender line and subject.

inputs.name: booking_notes
inputs.label: Booking notes
inputs.hint: Facts from the booking system. Leave empty if there is no booking yet.

output.description: Plain-text email: a Subject line, a body of 180 words or fewer, then an internal note for the sender.

do: Read the draft and the internal note before sending.
Add booking facts in Booking notes so the draft never has to guess.
Send exceptions and complaints to the Manager exactly as the internal note says.
dont: Do not paste card numbers or passport details into the assistant.
Do not promise a refund because the draft sounds kind.
Do not send a draft that quotes a price you cannot find in the price list.

modelSettings.notes: Low temperature keeps wording close to the policy. Web browsing off so prices only come from the knowledge files.

paste.chatgpt: Explore GPTs, Create, Configure tab. Paste the Instructions block into Instructions, upload the three knowledge files under Knowledge, switch Web search and Code interpreter off.
paste.claude: Projects, Create project. Paste instructions.md into Set project instructions and add the three knowledge files under Project knowledge.

examples.title: Italian client asks for a refund inside 24 hours
English price question with one item we do not sell
Albanian injury complaint with a legal threat
Client pastes a card number into the email
